test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

This medicine can make you feel __lethargic__ and dizzy.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Inactive".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

 
• Lethargic means ​'having little energy; feeling unwilling and unable to do anything (**थोड़ी ऊर्जा होना; अनिच्छुक महसूस करना और कुछ भी करने में असमर्थ होना**)**'.**

 
 
• ​Example: *Pallavi felt too miserable and **lethargic **to get dressed.*
